title: The River of Life and the Tree of Life in the New Jerusalem
description: John sees a river with the water of life, clear as crystal, flowing from the throne of God and of the Lamb in the middle of the city. On both sides of the river stands the tree of life, which bears twelve kinds of fruit each month, and its leaves bring healing to the nations. There is no curse anymore, and God's servants will serve him, see his face, and have his name on their foreheads. Night is gone, for the Lord God himself shines upon them, and they will reign forever and ever.
